headline: 小黄人蜘蛛侠领跑今日影视热搜
headlineEn: Minions and Spider-Man Top Today's Film Trends
summary: 今日影视热搜由《小黄人与大怪兽》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑；本周新片仅6部，蜘蛛侠持续霸榜。权力的游戏前传、Ted Lasso等剧集也受关注，接下来《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》即将登场。
summaryEn: Today's entertainment buzz is led by Minions and the Big Monster and Spider-Man: Brand New Day; with 6 new movies this week, Spider-Man keeps topping charts. Series like House of the Dragon and Ted Lasso also gain attention, while Escape from Death Street and OK Boss Lady 2 are upcoming.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周共6部新片入市。
industryHighlights.en: No new releases today; 6 new movies hit theaters this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》连续领跑本周热搜，成为暑期档焦点。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leads the weekly charts, becoming a summer season focus.

industryHighlights.text: 《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》位列待映片单，引发期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming titles Escape from Death Street and OK Boss Lady 2 draw anticipation.

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》《Ted Lasso》《痴迷》等剧集本周热度亮眼。
industryHighlights.en: Series such as House of the Dragon, Ted Lasso, and Obsession shine on this week's charts.
